title: regress_out
description:
Regress out (mostly) unwanted sources of variation.
Uses simple linear regression. This is inspired by Seurat's regressOut function in R [Satija15]. 
Note that this function tends to overcorrect in certain circumstances as described in issue theislab/scanpy#526.
See https://github.com/theislab/scanpy/issues/526.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, default: `output.h5mu`, direction: `output`

modality.description: Which modality (one or more) to run this component on.

input_layer.description:
The layer of the adata object to regress on.
If not provided, the X attribute of the adata object will be used.

output_layer.description:
The layer of the adata object containing the regressed count data.
If not provided, the X attribute of the adata object will be used.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
